requirements: Each substitution names one canonical active tool in replace and one enabled optional tool in with.
No canonical slot or optional candidate may appear more than once.
Unknown tools, implicit displacement, duplicate entries, disabled providers, non-native selected implementations, or an active count above twelve fail startup.
The displaced implementation remains present in the product and can be restored by configuration; substitution does not delete capability code.
